user.title: Welcome to Niak Weather
user.description:
Niak Weather is the brain of the weather at home: it reads your forecast, your station and the air quality, then works out what they mean.

Four steps, each already filled with what Home Assistant knows:
1. **Weather**: the forecast source.
2. **Station**: your sensors, if any.
3. **Air and pollen**: optional.
4. **Sensors**: what you want for your automations.

Everything can be changed later in **Configure**.

menu_options.import_card: Start from a Niak Weather card’s settings

import_card.title: Start from a card
import_card.description: Choose the card. Its settings are shown at each step, to check them.

weather.title: Step 1 of 4 · Weather
weather.description: The forecast source and the name of the place.

data_description.location: Shown at the top of the card.
data_description.season_entity: Optional. Without a sensor, the season follows the date.

data_description.station_history: Rain totals, temperature trend and the day’s strongest gust, when the station does not provide them.

station_sensors.title: Step 2 of 4 · Station sensors
station_sensors.description: Check each sensor. Leave empty what the station does not measure.

pollen_sensors.title: Step 3 of 4 · {source} sensors
pollen_sensors.description: The species to follow (and, for Polleninformation, the overall allergy risk), proposed by Niak: check, add or remove. Without an overall risk, Niak keeps the highest species.

data_description.pollen_risk_entity: Optional. Without it, Niak uses the highest species.

families.title: Step 4 of 4 · Sensors and automations
families.description: Tick what you want to use. The entities of these families will be enabled when their source is there. Each one can be changed later in **Configure**.

summary.title: Summary

air_quality.title: Step 3 of 4 · Air quality
air_quality.description: Your town’s air index and its pollutants, published by Atmo France. « None »: no air quality.{hint}

pollen.title: Step 3 of 4 · Pollen
pollen.description: Where the pollen comes from: Atmo France (index 1 to 6), Polleninformation or IRM KMI for Belgium (levels 0 to 4). With Polleninformation or IRM KMI, you will choose its sensors next.

pollen_area.title: Step 3 of 4 · Atmo zone for pollen
pollen_area.description: The Atmo France town whose pollen Niak reads.

error.atmo_missing: Atmo France is not installed. Install the Atmo France integration (github.com/sebcaps/atmofrance), then come back.
error.polleninformation_missing: Polleninformation is not installed. Install the Polleninformation EU integration (github.com/krissen/polleninformation), then come back.
error.irm_kmi_missing: IRM KMI is not installed, or gives no pollen. Install the IRM KMI integration from HACS (github.com/jdejaegh/irm-kmi-ha), then come back.
